name: ky-food-delivery-system
description: KY Food Delivery System - Multi-platform Food Delivery Application

scripts.build:all: npm run build:public && npm run build:admin && npm run build:kitchen && npm run build:manager && npm run build:delivery
scripts.dev:all: npm run dev:public & npm run dev:admin & npm run dev:kitchen & npm run dev:manager & npm run dev:delivery
scripts.install:all: npm install && cd domains/public && npm install && cd ../admin && npm install && cd ../kitchen && npm install && cd ../manager && npm install && cd ../delivery && npm install
scripts.tauri:dev: npm run dev & npx tauri dev
scripts.tauri:build: npm run build && npx tauri build

author: KY Foods
